description: Questions in everyday language, each with the section(s) a correct answer must cite. A question passes if ANY expected section appears in the top results. Every expected section was checked against the section text in data/processed/. 'tuning' cases may be used to choose settings; 'held_out' cases must NEVER be used for tuning - they only check whether improvements work on unseen questions. 'out_of_scope' cases are NOT about the IPR Acts; they have no expected sections and check that the assistant says it cannot answer instead of using outside knowledge. 'fresh' cases (added 2026-11-06, questions 1-5 written by the project owner) were written before the clause-level search change and have not been used for any decision. 'fresh2' cases (2026-11-06, written by the project owner) confirm the query-rewriting decision; the owner's 3 non-IPR questions from that batch are in 'out_of_scope'. 'multilingual' cases (Hindi/Hinglish, written by the assistant) test non-English questions.

cases.question: Someone is selling products with my registered trademark on them. What can I do?
cases.why: S.29 defines infringement of a registered trade mark; s.135 lists reliefs (injunction, damages).

cases.question: Can I sue someone for using my brand name if I never registered it?
cases.why: S.27: no infringement action for an unregistered mark, but passing off remains available.

cases.question: Why could my trademark application be rejected?
cases.why: S.9 absolute and s.11 relative grounds for refusal of registration.

cases.question: How long is a trademark registration valid and how do I renew it?
cases.why: S.25(1): registration is for ten years and may be renewed.

cases.question: Can I use a song in my YouTube video without permission?
cases.why: S.51 defines infringement; s.52 lists acts that are not infringement (fair dealing).

cases.question: How long does copyright last for a book after the author dies?
cases.why: S.22: sixty years from the year after the author's death.

cases.question: My employer says they own the articles I wrote at work. Who owns the copyright?
cases.why: S.17: first owner of copyright, including works made in the course of employment.

cases.question: Someone copied my book and is selling it. What legal action can I take?
cases.why: S.55 civil remedies, s.63 criminal offence, s.51 what counts as infringement.

cases.question: What is the jail punishment for copyright piracy?
cases.why: S.63: imprisonment of six months to three years and a fine.

cases.question: How do I register my copyright?
cases.why: S.45: application to the Registrar of Copyrights to enter particulars of a work in the Register.

cases.question: Is software patentable in India?
cases.why: S.3(k): a computer programme per se is not an invention.

cases.question: How long does a patent last?
cases.why: S.53: term of patent is twenty years from the date of filing.

cases.question: Who is allowed to apply for a patent?
cases.why: S.6: persons entitled to apply for patents.

cases.question: Can I file a patent in the US first if I live in India?
cases.why: S.39: residents need a written permit before applying outside India.

cases.question: Can someone challenge or oppose my patent?
cases.why: S.25: opposition to the patent (pre-grant and post-grant).

cases.question: What exclusive rights does copyright give me over my novel?
cases.why: S.14: meaning of copyright - the exclusive rights to reproduce, publish, translate, adapt etc.

cases.question: Can I stop someone from distorting or mutilating my painting even after I sold it?
cases.why: S.57: author's special (moral) rights against distortion, mutilation or modification.

cases.question: How can I transfer the copyright of my book to a publisher?
cases.why: S.18 assignment of copyright; s.19 mode of assignment.

cases.question: Someone registered a brand name that I had been using for many years before them. Am I protected?
cases.why: S.34: saving for vested rights of a prior continuous user.

cases.question: Can my trademark be cancelled if I stop using it?
cases.why: S.47: removal from register on ground of non-use.

cases.question: Is it a crime to sell fake branded goods?
cases.why: S.103 penalty for applying false trade marks; s.104 penalty for selling goods with a false trade mark.

cases.question: How do I apply to register my logo as a trademark?
cases.why: S.18: application for registration.

cases.question: What rights do I get once my patent is granted?
cases.why: S.48: rights of patentees - exclusive right to prevent others making, using, selling, importing.

cases.question: Can another company force me to let them make my patented medicine?
cases.why: S.84: compulsory licences, available three years after grant.

cases.question: A company copied my patented invention. What can a court order against them?
cases.why: S.108: reliefs in infringement suits - injunction, damages or account of profits.

cases.question: What is the capital of France?
cases.why: General knowledge, not law.

cases.question: How do I file for divorce in India?
cases.why: Family law: not covered by the IPR Acts NyayaAI has.

cases.question: How much GST do I have to pay on a restaurant bill?
cases.why: Tax law: not covered by the IPR Acts NyayaAI has.

cases.question: Can someone use my YouTube video without my permission?
cases.why: S.14(d) exclusive rights in a cinematograph film; s.51 infringement; s.52 acts that are not infringement.
cases.author: project owner

cases.question: How long does copyright protection last in India?
cases.why: Ss.22-29: term depends on the type of work (s.25 omitted).
cases.author: project owner

cases.question: How can I register my startup's brand name as a trademark in India?
cases.why: S.18 application for registration; s.23 registration.
cases.author: project owner

cases.question: Someone is using a logo very similar to mine. What can I do?
cases.why: TM s.29 infringement by deceptively similar mark; s.27 passing off if unregistered; ss.134-135 suits and reliefs. A logo is also an artistic work (Copyright s.2(c)), so copyright infringement (s.51) is a valid alternative route.
cases.author: project owner

cases.question: Can I patent a software application or mobile app idea in India?
cases.why: S.3(k): a computer programme per se is not an invention.
cases.author: project owner

cases.question: Can I get a patent for a new method of treating a disease?
cases.why: S.3(i): processes for medicinal, surgical, curative or other treatment are not inventions.
cases.author: assistant

cases.question: Can I patent a new variety of rice seed that I developed?
cases.why: S.3(j): plants, seeds, varieties and species are not inventions.
cases.author: assistant

cases.question: Can I photocopy pages of a book for my own research?
cases.why: S.52(1)(a)(i): fair dealing for private or personal use, including research.
cases.author: assistant

cases.question: Can my product's packaging or colour scheme be protected as a trademark?
cases.why: S.2(zb): a trade mark may include shape of goods, packaging and combination of colours; s.2(m) definition of mark.
cases.author: assistant

cases.question: can i use someone's instagram reel to make a reel for my own
cases.why: S.14 owner's exclusive rights (film/sound recording); s.51 infringement; s.52 fair-dealing exceptions.
cases.author: project owner

cases.question: someone is using my company name but i have been using it for 10 years but never registered it
cases.why: S.27(2) passing off remains available for unregistered marks; s.34 prior user's vested rights against a later registration; s.134(1)(c) passing-off suit 'whether registered or unregistered'.
cases.author: project owner

cases.why: Land/constitutional law: not covered.
